result.title: Watching Itself Watch: Self-Auditing Visual Reliance for Video Reasoning
result.summary: Video reasoning hinges on a small number of visually decisive tokens embedded in otherwise largely language-driven chains of thought. Yet prevailing post-training methods such as GRPO overlook this structure, assigning coarse trajectory-level rewards while requiring multiple rollouts and often costly external judges. We introduce Visually-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation (VIOS), a post-training framework that identifies where a model under-utilizes visual evidence and concentrates learning at those positions. Our key insight is that a model can audit its own visual reliance: the divergence between its next-token distributions with and without the video reveals how strongly each prediction depends on the visual input. Measuring this reliance for both a student and an answer-privileged teacher exposes a per-token reliance gap, identifying positions where the teacher exploits visual evidence that the student overlooks. VIOS translates this signal into dense, targeted supervision through three complementary components: an exponential moving average (EMA) teacher that co-evolves with the student, a contrastive objective that encourages predictions to depend on the video, and a reliance-gap gate that focuses learning on visually under-utilized tokens. Crucially, VIOS requires only a single on-policy rollout from a single model, without external rewards, judges, or larger teachers. Across 12 benchmarks spanning general, temporal, spatial, knowledge-intensive, and long-video understanding, VIOS consistently improves three model backbones and outperforms contemporary video-reasoning systems, while training in over 9x fewer steps, 60x fewer FLOPs, and 111x fewer generated tokens. Project page: https://vision.cs.utexas.edu/projects/VIOS/

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VIOS 后训练框架：以「有/无视频」两种条件下下一 token 分布的散度衡量逐位置视觉依赖，再由学生与答案特权教师的 reliance gap 定位视觉未被利用的 token，并用 EMA 教师、对比目标与门控实现稠密监督，单次 rollout 无需外部奖励或大教师。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐 token 视觉依赖差异直接对应「答案是否真正使用视觉证据」与贡献分配问题，其有/无视觉输入的对照可能为诊断视觉旁路和筛选视觉证据提供可核查信号；需注意它是训练期监督方法，而非推理期 latent 状态生成。
